_about: What an energy shot does to the world where it ends (sim/world/blast.gd; docs/world/ground-contact.md section 23). Per shot kind (data/fight/shots.json): craterE the crater's energy at tier 1 (1 is a scuff: a slam at 900 speed; the bowl radius is 160 units times its square root), radius and damage the structure blast at tier 1 (units, hit points), the effect counts and the shake. tierEnergy and tierDamage multiply by the shooter's tier 1 to 4. The structure reach by tier (fighter ladder reach.structure) and the casualty window apply as for any blast.
